title: A Review of Indoor Positioning Systems for UAV Localization with Machine Learning Algorithms
authors: Sandamini C.; Maduranga M.W.P.; Tilwari V.; Yahaya J.; Qamar F.; Nguyen Q.N.; Ibrahim S.R.A.
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
